items: 1 cup green beans, cut into 2-3 cm lengths
⅔ cup low sodium chicken broth or water

steps: Combine sauce ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly, then set aside.
Heat a wok to medium high and stir fry garlic and shallots for around 2 minutes.
Add sambal olek and stir fry for a further minute.
Turn heat to high and add kangaroo mince, breaking it up with a wooden spoon.
Cook kangaroo until it starts to brown and crisp up, about 5 minutes.
Add green beans and cook for two minutes.
Pour the sauce around the edges of the wok and stir through the mixture, cook on high for a minute.
Deglaze the wok with the chicken stock, allowing it to cook off quickly.
Cut the heat, add in the basil and allow it to wilt. Serve immediately over rice or noodles.

notes: When frying the kangaroo, try to evaporate off any water and get a nice char on the mince.

recipe_info.title: Kangaroo Pad Kra Pao
recipe_info.intro: A tasty, flavoursome meal that comes together quickly - the protein can be subbed out for tofu mince, beef or chicken.
